purpose: Durable negative evidence from the corrected period-compatible Snes9x 1.51 progression replay before the final acceptance discriminator.

baseline.note: The armed runtime baseline rules out an already-completed ordinary medal matrix as the explanation for the bounded negative result.

bounded_result.frontend_behavior_after_lua_terminal_sta: The historical Lua bridge terminated its Lua thread, while the emulator frontend remained alive at the terminal guest frame until the workflow watchdog.

related_retained_evidence.current_core_raw_input_fidelity: analysis/generated/historical-2014-first-race-replay.json records divergence beginning at sampled frame 440; raw current-core replay is therefore not an equivalent substitute for the period-compatible movie path.
related_retained_evidence.period_reference: analysis/generated/historical-2014-first-race-reference.json records first active race at frame 794 and first race-results state at frame 2874.

rules_out: A medal award occurring at or before guest frame 200000 under the now-known-incompatible -nosound replay configuration.
An already-completed ordinary rows 0..7 medal matrix at the armed runtime baseline.
does_not_rule_out: The verified historical movie producing authentic medal awards under its required APU/sound-sync configuration.
The period-compatible Snes9x 1.51 v7.1 path itself.
interpretation.next_discriminator: Replay the same movie in Snes9x 1.51 v7.1 with APU emulation enabled, explicit -soundsync, and host output muted via -mute; accept only a model-valid game-authored medal mutation followed by fresh-process reload.

exact_incompatibility.cause: The historical workflow launched Snes9x 1.51 v7.1 with -nosound. In this emulator, -nosound sets Settings.NextAPUEnabled = FALSE. Submission #4250 is verified with sound synchronization enabled, while the movie loader does not restore Settings.SoundSync from the movie flags. The resulting replay therefore disabled APU emulation on a sound-sync-sensitive movie and desynchronized during the first race.
evidence: TASVideos submission #4250 identifies Snes9x 1.51 v17 and sync verification in Snes9x 1.51 v7.1 with Sync samples enabled.
TASEmulators/snes9x-rr tag snes9x-151-v7.1 resolves to e0b6a74, confirming the branch already used the correct emulator release.
Snes9x 1.51 v7.1 command-line parsing sets Settings.NextAPUEnabled = FALSE for -nosound; -soundsync explicitly enables Settings.SoundSync.
The previous replay remained in the first active-race state at guest frame 200000 instead of following the retained verified reference path to race results near frame 2874.
exact_incompatibility.note: -mute suppresses host audio output without disabling APU emulation.
